settings.showZoomIndicator.label: Show current zoom percentage on the photo
status.noSupportedImagesButSubfolders.on: No supported images directly in this folder, but there is {count} subfolder.
status.noSupportedImagesButSubfolders.ot: No supported images directly in this folder, but there are {count} subfolders.
main.menu.openInExternalEditor.automatio: Open the current photo in the external editor
settings.externalEditorPath.label: Editor executable path
settings.externalEditorPath.hint: Right-click a photo > Open in External Editor launches this executable with the photo's path as argument. Leave empty to hide that menu item.
settings.showZoomMenuItems.label: Show zoom items (Fit, Zoom to N%, Zoom)
settings.showZoomMenuItems.automationNam: Show zoom items in the right-click menu
settings.showZoomMenuItems.hint: Off (default) hides Fit to window, Zoom to N% and the Zoom submenu from the right-click menu. Their shortcuts keep working either way.
settings.showRecycleMenuItem.label: Show Move to Recycle Bin item
settings.showRecycleMenuItem.automationN: Show the Move to Recycle Bin item in the right-click menu
settings.showRecycleMenuItem.hint: Off (default) hides Move to Recycle Bin from the right-click menu. The Move to Recycle Bin shortcut keeps working either way.
core.recovery.alreadyHandled: This entry was already handled by another PhotoReview window, or is being retried there right now. Nothing was changed; the entry has been removed from this list.
recovery.retry.stale.title: Already handled elsewhere
settings.rawSupportEnabled.label: Enable Camera RAW support (.cr2, .cr3, .nef, .arw, .dng, .raf, .orf, .rw2)
settings.rawSupportEnabled.hint: Loads embedded JPEG previews from camera RAW files for fast viewing and navigation.
settings.rawFullDecode.label: RAW full decode (demosaic)
settings.rawFullDecode.hint: Never: always shows the fast embedded preview and never decodes the sensor data, even when zoomed in. On zoom: decodes the sensor data at full resolution when you zoom in beyond the preview.
settings.rawPairMode.label: JPEG+RAW pairs
settings.rawPairMode.hint: How pairs with matching names in the same folder are grouped.
image.error.rawNoPreview: This RAW file has no embedded preview, so it cannot be shown.
status.groupPartnerMissing: {fileName}: companion file(s) were missing on disk ({missing}), so the action was applied to the remaining files.
core.groupAction.rollbackFailed: {message} In addition, {count} file(s) that were already processed could not be put back automatically; check Recovery.
core.undo.groupPartiallyRestored: Restored {restored} of {total} files. Could not restore (deleted permanently): {names}
status.lateDeletedPartlyPermanently: {fileName} was moved to the Recycle Bin after you left its folder, except {permanentFiles}, which could not go to the Recycle Bin and was deleted permanently.
recovery.group.retryConfirmPermanent: Retry {operation} for {count} capture-group members? {permanentCount} of them are on drives without a Recycle Bin and will be deleted PERMANENTLY. This cannot be undone. Completed members will be skipped.
recovery.group.retryConfirmRestore: Restore capture-group members from the Recycle Bin (up to {count})? Members that are already back will be skipped.
core.journal.cancelledByUser: The operation was cancelled before it finished.
core.journal.unrepresentablePath: A file path contains an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate, which cannot be recorded faithfully in the operation journal. Nothing was changed.
core.recovery.cancelledNeedsConfirm: You cancelled this operation earlier. Retrying would finish it, so it needs an explicit confirmation in the Recovery window. Nothing was changed.
recovery.retryConfirmCancelled: You cancelled this {operation} earlier. Retrying will FINISH it for {count} file(s). Continue?
image.error.rawDisabled: RAW support is turned off in Settings, so {fileName} cannot be shown.
status.groupChangedDuringConfirm: {fileName}: the capture changed while the confirmation was open, so nothing was changed. Try again.
dialog.confirmCompareGroupRecycle.messag: '{fileName}' is part of a JPEG+RAW capture: this will also send its paired file(s) to the Recycle Bin. Files: {files}. Continue?
dialog.confirmCompareGroupMove.message: '{fileName}' is part of a JPEG+RAW capture: this will also move its paired file(s). Files: {files}. Continue?
status.lateGroupPartiallyProcessed: {fileName}: the action failed part-way after you left its folder; {done} of {total} file(s) were already processed. Ctrl+Z restores what went to the Recycle Bin; check Recovery for the rest.
recovery.retryConfirmCancelledPermanent: You cancelled this {operation} earlier. Retrying will FINISH it for {count} file(s); {permanentCount} of them are on drives without a Recycle Bin and will be deleted PERMANENTLY. This cannot be undone. Continue?
main.capturePair.badge.tooltipBound: Press {key} to switch between the JPEG and the RAW of this capture.
main.capturePair.badge.tooltipUnbound: No key is assigned to switch between the JPEG and the RAW. Assign one in Settings > Shortcuts ("Switch JPEG / RAW member"), or use Compare.
settings.rawPairMode.shortcutHint: In the stacked modes only one file of a pair is shown. To see the other one, assign a key to "Switch JPEG / RAW member" under Shortcuts (no key is assigned by default), or open Compare.
settings.load.shortcutDisabled: The shortcut for {name} conflicted with another action and was turned off. You can assign it again in Settings > Shortcuts.
core.recovery.busy: A file action is still running. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
recovery.readFailed: The Recovery list could not be read from the operation journal: {reason}
status.lateBatchRecycled: Duplicate cleanup finished after you left the folder: {done} file(s) moved to the Recycle Bin, {failed} failed. This cleanup cannot be undone with Ctrl+Z; open the Recycle Bin to restore files.
core.recovery.conflict: Files exist at both the source and the destination; retry refused so that nothing is overwritten. Resolve the duplicate by hand.
core.recovery.destinationChanged: The file at the destination is no longer the one that was moved; retry refused to protect your data.
core.fileAction.groupNeedsTwoPaths: A grouped file action needs at least two files.
